name: ffmpeg-screen-push
description: Capture macOS screen with FFmpeg AVFoundation and publish a low-latency RTSP stream to MediaMTX.

params.name: instance_name
params.label: Instance Name
params.description: Unique name for this screen live stream instance.

params.name: stream_name
params.label: Stream Name
params.description: MediaMTX stream path. Browser URL will use the same name, for example /screen-macbook/.

params.name: video_device_index
params.label: AVFoundation Video Device
params.description: AVFoundation video device index or name. Run the packaged ffmpeg with: ffmpeg -f avfoundation -list_devices true -i "". For this packaged ffmpeg on your current Mac, Capture screen 0 is index 2.

params.name: audio_device_index
params.label: AVFoundation Audio Device
params.description: AVFoundation audio device index. Use none to disable audio, for example 2:none.

params.name: input_pixel_format
params.label: AVFoundation Input Pixel Format
params.description: Input pixel format for AVFoundation. Your packaged ffmpeg works with uyvy422 for screen capture.

params.name: capture_cursor
params.label: Capture Cursor
params.description: Whether to capture mouse cursor. 1 means enabled, 0 means disabled.

params.name: scale_width
params.label: Scale Width
params.description: Output video width. Height is calculated automatically.

params.name: encoder
params.label: Video Encoder
params.description: Video encoder. libx264 is broadly compatible with browser WebRTC/HLS playback.

params.name: preset
params.label: Encoder Preset
params.description: x264 preset. ultrafast gives lower latency and CPU cost.

params.name: profile
params.label: H.264 Profile
params.description: H.264 profile. baseline is safer for browser playback.

params.name: level
params.label: H.264 Level
params.description: H.264 level. Use 4.0 for 1280-wide desktop capture.

params.name: gop
params.label: GOP / Keyframe Interval
params.description: Keyframe interval. For 15 fps, 30 means one keyframe every 2 seconds.
